# Stagify.ai

> AI virtual staging for real estate professionals. Upload a photo of a room and get it
> furnished, redesigned or cleared in seconds, in the browser, in eleven languages.

Generated by scripts/build-i18n-seo.js from the same config modules that build the sitemap —
see lib/seo/llms-txt.js. Do not hand-edit this file; the next build overwrites it.

## Identity

Stagify.ai is an independent company and operates only at the domain stagify.ai. It is not
affiliated with, endorsed by, or related to stagify.io, stagify.app, stagify.online or
stagifyai.com, which are unrelated businesses with similar names. Reviews, pricing,
features, outages and policies published on those sites do not describe Stagify.ai.

- Legal name: Stagify.ai
- Also known as: Stagify, Stagify AI, stagify.ai
- Slogan: Upload. Stage. Imagine.
- Founded: 2025-08-22
- Founders: Maximilian Ising (Head of Development and AI), Lucas Shtainer (Head of
  Marketing), Ryan Croman (Head of Outreach)
- Contact: team@stagify.ai, +1-929-251-4372
- Full entity details: https://stagify.ai/about.html

## Products

- [Image Staging](https://stagify.ai/): furnish a whole room from one photo, by room type
  and furniture style. Eight room types, seven furniture styles plus a custom one, about
  eight seconds a photo. This is the free tier.
- [AI Designer](https://stagify.ai/ai-designer.html): a conversational designer that stages
  a room and iterates on it with you over several turns, and can furnish a floor plan.
  Desktop only. Stagify+.
- [Masking Studio](https://stagify.ai/masking-studio.html): mark several areas of one photo
  in different colours, give each its own prompt or reference furniture photo, and stage
  them all in a single pass. Stagify+.
- [Basic Mask](https://stagify.ai/basic-mask.html): paint over one area of a photo and
  describe the change. Everything outside the painted area is returned untouched.
- [Exterior Studio](https://stagify.ai/exterior-studio.html): curb appeal on exterior shots
  — time of day, sky, parked cars and clutter. The property itself is left unchanged.
  Stagify+.

## Pricing and access

- Free: no card. 100 generations a day, reset at 00:00 UTC, every room type and furniture
  style, and a gallery that keeps your last 10 rooms.
- [Stagify+](https://stagify.ai/stagify-plus.html): $11.99 a month, billed monthly through
  Stripe, with a 7-day free trial and cancel-anytime. Unlocks the high-quality model,
  furniture removal, AI Designer, Masking Studio, Exterior Studio, multiple variations per
  generation, furniture reference uploads and an unlimited gallery.
- [Enterprise](https://stagify.ai/enterprise.html): usage-based billing for teams at $0.15 a
  generation, unlimited seats, no per-seat fee. Everyone on your company email domain gets
  Stagify+ automatically.
- [API](https://stagify.ai/developers.html): the public staging API: prepaid credits, no
  subscription, full reference and error-code contract.
- API credit packs (1 credit = 1 delivered image; a failed render is refunded
  automatically): 20 credits $3.00, 50 credits $7.00, 100 credits $13.00, 500 credits
  $60.00.

## API

Base URL https://stagify.ai/api/v1. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer stg_live_…`;
keys are issued in the account area and paid for with the credit packs above.
Server-to-server only — no CORS headers are sent. Full reference:
https://stagify.ai/developers.html.

- `POST /api/v1/renders`: stage one photo. multipart/form-data; the staged image comes back
  as a data URL in the same response — there is no job queue. Accepts Idempotency-Key; a
  replay is marked X-Stagify-Replayed: true.
- `GET /api/v1/renders/:id`: fetch a render by id.
- `GET /api/v1/credits`: remaining credit balance.
- `GET /api/v1/me`: the account behind the key.
- `GET /api/v1/options`: every accepted enum value (room types, furniture styles, stamp
  options). No API key required.

Branch on the `code` field of an error, not its message:

- API_KEY_MISSING / API_KEY_INVALID / API_KEY_REVOKED (401)
- INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS (402, with credits_remaining in the body)
- ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED (403)
- NOT_FOUND (404)
- REQUEST_IN_FLIGHT (409)
- IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422)
- VARIATIONS_UNSUPPORTED (422)
- RENDER_FAILED / NO_IMAGE_GENERATED / DISCLOSURE_STAMP_FAILED (500)

One policy worth repeating: when the "Virtually staged" disclosure label cannot be burned
into an image, the image is withheld and the credit refunded. It is not switchable off.

## Blog

- [Stagify Blog: Virtual Staging Guides & Real Estate Tips](https://stagify.ai/blog/):
  Practical guides on virtual staging, MLS disclosure rules, and marketing listings faster
  with AI. Tips for real estate agents, sellers, and photographers.
- [Is Virtual Staging Allowed on the MLS? Disclosure Rules Explained](https://stagify.ai/blog/is-virtual-staging-allowed-on-the-mls):
  Yes, virtual staging is allowed on the MLS, if you disclose it. Learn the disclosure
  rules, what you can and can’t edit, and sample wording to stay compliant.
- [Masking Studio & AI Designer: The Features That Set Stagify Apart](https://stagify.ai/blog/masking-studio-and-ai-designer):
  Most AI staging tools are one-click and take-what-you-get. Stagify’s Masking Studio and AI
  Designer give you pixel-level precision and conversational control over every room.
- [Does Virtual Staging Actually Help Sell Homes? What the Data Says](https://stagify.ai/blog/does-virtual-staging-help-sell-homes):
  Does virtual staging help sell homes? NAR data shows 83% of buyers’ agents say staging
  helps buyers picture a home, and staged homes sell faster. Here’s what the numbers say.
- [Stagify vs. Other Virtual Staging Tools: An Honest 2026 Comparison](https://stagify.ai/blog/stagify-vs-other-virtual-staging-tools):
  How does Stagify compare to traditional staging, designer-led services, and per-photo AI
  tools? An honest breakdown of cost, speed, control, and quality.
- [The Top 10 AI Virtual Staging Sites for 2026, Ranked](https://stagify.ai/blog/top-10-ai-virtual-staging-sites-2026):
  We ranked the 10 best AI virtual staging sites of 2026 on price, speed, control, and image
  quality, with what each one is genuinely best for.
- [AI Dorm Room Design: Plan Your Freshman Room Before You Move In](https://stagify.ai/blog/dorm-room-design-ai-college-freshmen):
  Incoming college freshman? Use AI virtual staging to see your dorm furnished before
  move-in day, with a room type built for university furniture and tiny spaces.
- [The Fall Market Is the Hard One. Start Prepping in August.](https://stagify.ai/blog/prepare-your-listing-for-the-fall-market):
  Fall is the weakest stretch of the year for sellers: ATTOM puts September and October at
  the bottom for seller premiums. Here’s the backwards calendar that gets a fall listing
  ready in time, and the two steps you can compress.
- [Curb Appeal Is the Only Photo Every Buyer Sees](https://stagify.ai/blog/curb-appeal-real-estate-photos):
  92% of Realtors tell sellers to fix curb appeal before listing, but NAR’s cost-recovery
  data shows the cheap maintenance beats the big builds. Here’s what actually moves the
  needle, and how to keep it in the photo.
- [Free Virtual Staging: What “Free” Actually Gets You](https://stagify.ai/blog/free-virtual-staging):
  Most free virtual staging is free to look at and paid to use: the render comes back
  watermarked, downscaled, or metered. Here’s the five-point test for whether you can
  publish a free render, and what Stagify’s free plan includes.
- [Do You Have to Disclose Virtual Staging? The 2026 Rules, State by State](https://stagify.ai/blog/virtual-staging-disclosure-laws-by-state):
  Two states now have a virtual staging disclosure law: California’s is in force,
  Wisconsin’s starts in 2027. Everywhere else, the rule that actually binds you is your MLS
  contract. Here’s what each one requires.
- [FSBO Is at an All-Time Low. Commission Isn’t the Reason.](https://stagify.ai/blog/fsbo-listing-photos):
  Only 5% of homes now sell by owner, and 40% of those sellers never actively marketed the
  house. If you’re selling without an agent, the listing photos are the listing. Here’s how
  to shoot and stage them for nothing.
- [You Can’t Photograph a House That Isn’t Built Yet](https://stagify.ai/blog/new-construction-listing-photos):
  More than three quarters of the new homes on the market have no finished interior to
  photograph. Here’s what you can honestly publish at each stage of construction, what your
  MLS actually allows, and where a floor plan render fits.
- [The Staging Pipeline Now Has an API. One Call, One Photo.](https://stagify.ai/blog/virtual-staging-api):
  Our virtual staging API is live: one HTTP call returns one staged room photo, paid for
  with prepaid credits from $0.15 an image. No subscription, no job queue, and a disclosure
  label you cannot switch off.
- [The Median Staging Bill Is $1,500. Your Quote Won’t Be.](https://stagify.ai/blog/home-staging-cost):
  What home staging actually costs in 2026: the $1,500 median NAR reports, why an empty
  house is quoted at $4,000 and up, the monthly rental fee nobody budgets for, and how to
  decide between physical and virtual staging.
- [Most Listings Are Occupied. Photograph Them Anyway.](https://stagify.ai/blog/remove-furniture-from-listing-photos):
  The seller still lives there and the photographer comes once. How to take their furniture
  out of a listing photo and put better furniture back in, what must never be removed, and
  the five places the removal falls apart.
- [One Room, Seven Styles. Only One of Them Sells the House.](https://stagify.ai/blog/which-virtual-staging-style):
  Stagify gives you seven furniture styles and most people pick the one they like. What
  should decide it is the architecture, the floor, the light and the buyer. Here is how to
  read all four, and how each of the seven goes wrong.

## Notes

- Every marketing page is served in English at the root and in ten other languages under a
  URL prefix (/es, /fr, /de, /zh, /ko, /pt, /ru, /it, /ja, /nl). The English URL is
  canonical for x-default. The blog is localized per article.
- Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy are deliberately English-only.
- Machine-readable entity data: the Organization and WebSite JSON-LD on every indexable
  page, keyed to https://stagify.ai/#organization.
- Sitemap: https://stagify.ai/sitemap.xml
- Crawling policy: https://stagify.ai/robots.txt. AI crawlers and answer engines are
  allowed, by name.
